Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Robert Gantz, Collector
Cardtype: Ally
Cost: 2 pool
Unique ally with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
When Robert Gantz enters play, or by discarding a copy of Robert Gantz as a master phase action, you may search your library for a trophy card and put it on him. He may search your library or ash heap for a trophy card to put on him as a +1 stealth action. If that action is blocked, he may burn a trophy on him to cancel combat. You may award trophy cards on him when a Red List minion is burned as if they were in play.

A useful addition to trophy decks. It makes the setup easier for them, saving some master phase actions and allowing to fetch the desired trophies early.
Robert can be included in multiple copies and can be used as "proxies" for trophies.

The name is absolutely non-canonical, I just made it like that. If someone has a better canonical idea, I can change his name.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Mael
Messages.Body:
It should probably include the text that he does not get the benefit of trophies on him, or that they are out of play or something. I think at the moment all trophies specify 'vampire' on them, but it's no harm to explicitly state it.
Apart from that, it seems to be on the weak side of balanced. I don't think I'd include it in a trophy deck. (Reason for that is that around here it would almost certainly die before I could get anything off it, that's possibly just the local meta though).

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: So Infernal Pursuit to discard trophies during combat, the Summoning to go fish for the collector and Caiaphas Smith/Informant, and you're ready to go? That would work with plenty of clans but it feels more like a stupid turbo deck than what a trophy deck should be. Maybe have that special on an Equipment instead of an Ally to break the Collector/Caiaphas/Summoning mechanic?

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> And why an equipment would be more balanced than an ally?
>
It is already written above: if the combo is based on 2 allies, then you can greatly impprove the card flow with the Summoning: it helps you draw all the different pieces early instead of several of the same and it trims your deck of the superfluous copies. Any improvement to trophies is likely to improve the Caiaphas trick as well, but if that improvement is another ally then you improve the Caiaphas trick more than other trophy decks.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Hm, I have a final idea because I don't like much recursivity.

Name: Robert Gantz, Collector
Cardtype: Retainer
Unique mortal with 2 life. Requires a ready titled vampire.
If Robert's employer is ready, you may spend a discard phase action to put a trophy card from your hand into play.
It values a little DPA, speeds up trophy decks (instead of ending the turn with a trophy that jams the end until the next master phase) and is not recursive.
